write_up: Your resume is strong! It connects your outpatient orthopedic work at North Loop Sports Rehab to the patients you treat, a program you built and the therapists you mentor. A recruiter can see both your clinical work and your senior responsibilities.

The return-to-run line is a model: it names the program you built and tells a recruiter how many patients completed it. Your Minnesota license and DPT are easy to find, too. The functional score result is promising, but the measure and number of patients behind the percentage would make it more useful.
Start with that score line, then leave the return-to-run line alone. Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a call back; the competitiveness of a particular role will matter too.
